permissions.purpose: Creates a webhook endpoint on the merchant's Stripe account so completed checkouts are forwarded to FiscalLink for Romanian ANAF e-invoicing.
permissions.name: Create webhook endpoints that deliver checkout events to FiscalLink

permissions.purpose: Reads checkout session details (customer, line items, totals) to generate the EN 16931 / CIUS-RO UBL e-invoice.
permissions.name: Read checkout sessions to build the e-invoice

content_security_policy.purpose: The FiscalLink extension calls the FiscalLink Stripe App backend to save credentials, provision the webhook and report connection status.
